title: MPLS: Add a dissector table for first nibble, heuristic list
description:
Add a dissector table for the first nibble, and register
dissectors to that.

Add a heuristic dissector list, and register the Ethernet without
CW dissector to that.

Add a preference to try MPLS heuristic dissectors before the
first nibble handling; this is necessary for Ethernet addresses
that start with a 4 or 6 first nibble. Default it to off, because
Ethernet without CW was strongly recommended against by RFC 8469.

There's still the case of locally administered addresses (see #13039).
It might be possible with the Ethertype/length checks to allow
any locally administered addressses now; they can also be handled
by adding to the "ethers" file, which the heuristics now use.
Note that the manuf lookup does try clearing the broadcast bit.

Fix #13306.

commits_data.message:
MPLS: Add a dissector table for first nibble, heuristic list

Add a dissector table for the first nibble, and register
dissectors to that.

Add a heuristic dissector list, and register the Ethernet without
CW dissector to that.

Add a preference to try MPLS heuristic dissectors before the
first nibble handling; this is necessary for Ethernet addresses
that start with a 4 or 6 first nibble. Default it to off, because
Ethernet without CW was strongly recommended against by RFC 8469.

Add Decode as for this table. Previously we've been using the Eth
CW heuristic for first nibble 0; continue doing that.

There's still the case of locally administered addresses (see #13039).
It might be possible with the Ethertype/length checks to allow
any locally administered addressses now; they can also be handled
by adding to the "ethers" file, which the heuristics now use.
Note that the manuf lookup does try clearing the broadcast bit.

Fix #13306.
